record.tranche_reason: The paper tests fixed random labels and reports that deterministic models learn them, while CEB and VIB models at ρ < 6 do not learn them within 100 epochs. This refines the claim by showing the outcome differs with the training objective.
record.gate_note: The random-label experiment is reported in the Results text. The paper also cites Zhang et al. (2016), but those cited results are not included as rows.
record.test_reason: The study directly trains on fixed random Fashion MNIST labels and reports objective-dependent failure to learn. Its unregularized true-label models also bear on the necessity part of V5.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately summarizes the random-label conclusion: CEB and VIB at ρ < 6 fail to learn within 100 epochs, whereas deterministic models begin memorizing after about 40 epochs. The authors interpret this as evidence that limiting retained information improves robust generalization; they do not report numerical perfect-fit or chance-test-error results for this experiment.
record.recipe_differences: The random-label experiment follows Zhang et al. (2016) using Fashion MNIST images with fixed random labels. The paper compares deterministic, CEB, and VIB objectives; it does not report a reproduction of all original settings.
record.method_sensitivity: Training objective and ρ; CEB and VIB models with ρ < 6 do not learn the random labels within 100 epochs.
record.problems: The text reports learning or memorization qualitatively, without training or test error values, uncertainty estimates, or a stated optimizer for the random-label experiment.

untested.parts: Zero or near-zero training error and chance test error are not reported numerically. The random-label optimizer and unchanged hyperparameters relative to true-label training are not explicitly established.
No matched convergence-time comparison or corruption-fraction sweep; onset of memorization at 40 epochs does not establish a small constant training-time factor.
No fitting experiments on shuffled pixels, independently permuted pixels, or Gaussian-noise inputs.
No intermediate label-corruption fractions or corresponding training and test error curves.
No random-label comparisons with weight decay, dropout, or data augmentation enabled, and no controlled removal ablation. CEB and VIB penalties do not test the named regularizers.
No comparison of real-label and random-label learning trajectories, or separation of signal fitting from noise memorization.

missing.what: True-label Fashion MNIST test accuracy for the deterministic baseline without conventional regularization. This bears on whether useful generalization requires explicit regularization and should have its own row; exact plotted accuracy is unavailable in the supplied text.

record.verdict_notes: No positive V1 verdict is assigned to R1 because learning and beginning to memorize do not establish the version's near-zero training-error endpoint. Outcomes at ρ = 6 and 7 are not explicitly stated. Adam is specified in the CIFAR-10 appendix, so it should not automatically be attributed to the Fashion MNIST random-label experiment.

versions.untested_parts: The text does not state training error values or test error on the random-label task, and does not establish whether the deterministic models used stochastic gradient methods.

rows.subject: deterministic models
rows.operation_detail: Trained on Fashion MNIST images with fixed random labels.
rows.measure: Whether models learn or memorize the random labels
rows.value: The deterministic models always learn; after about 40 epochs they begin to memorize the random labels.
rows.note: The text does not give training error or test error values for these models.
rows.check: The authors report learning and the onset of memorization after about 40 epochs, but do not establish zero or near-zero training error. Appendix A.1 identifies the architecture as a 7×2 Wide ResNet encoder, four-dimensional representation, and two-layer MLP classifier.

rows.subject: CEB models
rows.operation_detail: Trained on Fashion MNIST images with fixed random labels, at ρ from 0 through 7.
rows.measure: Whether models learn the random labels
rows.value: The CEB models with ρ < 6 never learn, even after 100 epochs of training.
rows.note: Reported in aggregate for the CEB models with ρ < 6; the text does not give training error values.
rows.check: The reported failure to learn within 100 epochs is accurate. These are stochastic bottleneck models with a changed objective, so this qualifies extension of V1 to these objectives rather than contradicting the standard deterministic-network result.
